map.姓名 = 姓氏库随机抽样 1 个 + 风格字库随机抽样 1~2 个；每个候选名字: Name = 1 random draw from the surname pool + 1-2 random draws from the style character pool; each candidate is drawn independently, so a generation count of N means N independent draws within the candidate space (repeats allowed)
map.候选空间 = |姓氏库| × |风格字库|（单字或双字），中文名常见规模在万级到: Candidate space = |surname pool| x |style character pool| (single or double characters); Chinese names typically number in the tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands, so generating 10-50 at a time has a very low but non-zero repeat probability - repeats are normal randomness, not a defect. The style tag (classic / literary / vintage / modern / cute) determines which pool is used, and the "modern" style has an extra chance of collapsing to a single-character name, so name length naturally varies within one style. Results are only naming inspiration; before formal use, still check for duplicate names, homophones and company-name registration rules.
